symbols.name: number of axes
symbols.meaning: The number of axes (coordinates) of the array.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes and $q_i$ the number of positions along axis $i$, so $\boldsymbol q=(q_1,\dots,q_d)$.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of positions along axis i.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes and $q_i$ the number of positions along axis $i$, so $\boldsymbol q=(q_1,\dots,q_d)$.

symbols.name: number of entries
symbols.meaning: The number of entries of the array, the product of the axis lengths.
symbols.quote: Let $N=\prod_i q_i$ be the number of entries.

relations.quote: Each factor is a one-dimensional [Discrete Fourier transform](dft.md), so $F_{\boldsymbol q}$ is a tensor product of them:
Each line transform is computed by the [Butterflies and the fast transform](butterfly.md) in $O(q_i\log q_i)$ operations.
